source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: This CyrusOne campus sits in Aurora, Illinois. Wikipedia coverage of CyrusOne states the company completed an acquisition of a CME Group data center in Aurora in March 2016 and began construction of a 425,000 square foot expansion facility there. CyrusOne was founded in July 2000 by David Ferdman and Larry Bursten and was taken private in 2022 when Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Global Infrastructure Partners acquired it for 15 billion dollars. No building specific address or individual MW figures were located in available sourcing this session.

reading.body:
At 114 MW of published IT capacity across three buildings and 450,000 square feet, the Aurora campus is a large multi-building deployment. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 114 MW of IT load is roughly 2,850 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical enterprise or colocation average, the same power supports roughly 11,400 racks. The arithmetic is an assumption, not a CyrusOne claim. What the numbers do state directly is that 450,000 square feet of technical space spread across CHI1, CHI2, and CHI3 implies a campus built for scale rather than a single-tenant shell.

The campus holds a Green Globes certification, which qualifies it as having met a third-party environmental performance standard for building design and operations. No other certifications are published on the operator's spec page.

Among the 44 Illinois facilities this site has mapped, CyrusOne Aurora is ranked first by published IT capacity and accounts for all 114 MW of published capacity in the state, because it is the only facility among those 44 for which an operator spec page with a megawatt figure has been read. The 43 other mapped facilities publish no such figure, so the 114 MW total reflects a data gap rather than a true state-wide ceiling. Illinois is a meaningful AI infrastructure market by geography and grid access, but what share of actual deployed capacity this campus represents cannot be derived from the data available here.
